title: Write a CPlusPlus POP
summary: Official Derivative guide for CPlusPlus POP authoring, covering CPU/CUDA POP geometry creation, point/vertex/primitive attribute buffers, index buffers, topology metadata, line-strip restart rules, input-buffer reads, and CUDA synchronization.
guidance: Use this article when a plan needs native POP generation, POP topology authoring, or plugin-side POP buffer access beyond GLSL POP templates.
CPlusPlus POP can mix CPU memory and CUDA workflows, unlike CPlusPlus TOP's explicit execute-mode choice, but CUDA availability is platform and GPU dependent.
Do not reuse buffers after handing them back to TouchDesigner through setIndexBuffer() or setAttribute().
Attribute buffers are assigned by class using POP_AttributeInfo; downstream point/vertex/primitive counts are inferred from the smallest buffer in the class.
A POP has one index buffer; triangle, quad, line-strip, line, and point primitive groups must be ordered as expected by POP_TopologyInfo for efficient rendering.
Line strips require primitive restart index entries such as 0xFFFFFFFF and additional line-strip info buffers, so generated plans should not treat them like fixed-size triangles.

CUDA buffers must be created or acquired before beginCUDAOperations(), and GPU reads/writes known to TouchDesigner should occur between beginCUDAOperations() and endCUDAOperations() with a cudaStream_t.
